tokyo_sansou_cafe.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Transcribed from full-resolution photographs of the shop's own laminated bilingual menu cards, dated 2026/02 and 2026/05 on Tabelog, cross-checked against the shop's own site. Prices are shown tax-excluded with the tax-included figure alongside; the tax-included figure is quoted here. CLOSING: the shop posted a 閉店のお知らせ on 2026-07-27 saying it will close at the end of August 2026 — verify it is still trading before making the trip.

items.ja: 本日の酵素玄米プレート（酵素玄米と本日のメイン 季節の副菜のせ）
items.en: Today's enzyme brown rice plate — the house rice with a daily main and a spread of seasonal sides. The main changes daily; ask the staff what it is today
items.note: 店の掲示：「当店では小麦粉は使用しておりませんが、一部の料理のお醤油に製造過程でごく微量な小麦が含まれている可能性があります」。The shop's own card states no wheat flour is used in the kitchen, but some dishes use a soy sauce that may carry trace wheat from the brewing process — declare a severe allergy when you order. The main is usually fish or meat. +¥330 adds miso soup or the soup of the day.

items.ja: 酵素玄米 和風ガパオプレート 季節の副菜のせ
items.en: Japanese-style gapao plate on enzyme brown rice, with seasonal sides — minced chicken and tofu with a soft-boiled egg on top. Lighter than a Thai gapao and served with a Japanese hand
items.note: 小麦粉不使用だが、味付けの醤油に微量の小麦の可能性（店の掲示による）。No wheat flour, but the seasoning soy may carry trace wheat per the shop's own notice. The shop's Instagram says the gapao is made with chicken breast and tofu; egg on top. +¥330 for soup.

items.ja: 酵素玄米とグルテンフリー薬膳カレー
items.romaji: koso genmai to guruten furii yakuzen karee
items.en: Enzyme brown rice with the medicinal spice curry — built from vegetables and whole spices rather than a roux, and the dish the shop is best known for. A vegan version is available; chicken can be added
items.note: 店のメニューカードに「グルテンフリー・ヴィーガン対応」と明記、小麦のルウを使わないスパイスカレー。The card labels this dish outright as gluten-free with a vegan option — no wheat roux, which is what makes a Japanese curry unsafe. Ask for the vegan build; the default may carry dashi. +¥330 for a spice-and-dashi seasoned soft-boiled egg, which is neither vegan nor certain on the soy.

items.ja: 本日のおこめパンプレート（バジルパン、または黒糖パン）
items.en: Today's rice-bread plate — basil rolls or brown-sugar rolls, with salad, a frittata-style egg dish and a pot of cream
items.note: 米粉パン。当店では小麦粉は使用していないと店が明記しているため、共用の小麦生地は存在しない。Rice-flour bread — and because the shop states it uses no wheat flour at all in the kitchen, this is not the usual rice-flour-bakery trap where wheat is baked in the same room. Egg and dairy on the plate. +¥330 for soup.

items.ja: 酵素玄米おにぎりプレート
items.en: Enzyme brown rice onigiri plate — one rice ball with the filling of your choice, plus salad, pickles and side dishes. The simplest way to taste the rice itself
items.note: 酵素玄米（玄米と小豆）と海苔のみ。The rice is brown rice fermented with adzuki beans and salt — no wheat. Fillings are charged on top: sesame salt +¥55, olive oil and salt +¥55, tororo kombu +¥110, premium Kishu umeboshi +¥220, pickled young ginger +¥110 (seasonal). Extra onigiri ¥440. Ask about the side dishes for dashi if you are vegan.

items.ja: 酵素玄米おにぎり 追加
items.en: Extra enzyme brown rice onigiri — also the standalone price on the evening menu
items.note: 玄米・小豆・塩・海苔のみ。Brown rice, adzuki, salt and nori — nothing else, with a plain salt or olive-oil filling.

items.ja: お味噌汁 または 本日のスープ（追加）
items.en: Miso soup or the soup of the day, added to any plate
items.note: 味噌の種類と出汁が未記載。The shop selects its seasonings carefully but does not publish the miso variety or the stock — ask whether it is a rice miso and whether the dashi is bonito or kombu.

items.ja: キャロットケーキ（塩麹クリームチーズのせ）
items.en: Carrot cake with salt-koji cream cheese — plenty of fresh carrot and spice, topped with a quenelle of cream cheese cured in shio-koji. The shop's headline sweet
items.section: 季節の野菜スイーツ Gluten-free sweets
items.note: メニューカードに GLUTEN FREE と明記、当店では小麦粉不使用。Labelled GLUTEN FREE on the card, and the shop states no wheat flour enters the kitchen at all. Cream cheese and egg, so not vegan. Takeaway ¥648.

items.ja: 黒ごまさつまいもケーキ（黒蜜添え）
items.en: Black sesame and sweet potato cake with kuromitsu syrup — steamed sweet potato through a soft crumb, gently sweet
items.section: 季節の野菜スイーツ Gluten-free sweets
items.note: メニューカードに GLUTEN FREE と明記、小麦粉不使用。Labelled GLUTEN FREE on the card; the shop uses no wheat flour. Egg and dairy likely — ask. Takeaway ¥648.

items.ja: 季節のグルテンフリーケーキ
items.en: Seasonal gluten-free cake — a loaf that changes with what is in season; ask the staff what it is
items.section: 季節の野菜スイーツ Gluten-free sweets
items.note: メニューカードに GLUTEN FREE と明記、小麦粉不使用。Labelled GLUTEN FREE on the card. Contents change, so confirm the eggs and dairy for the day. Takeaway ¥648.

items.ja: ケーキとお飲みものセット
items.en: Cake and drink set, for guests who have ordered a meal — today's gluten-free cake in a slightly smaller slice, plus coffee, mint green tea or black tea
items.note: セットのケーキもグルテンフリー。The set cake is the same gluten-free bake, just cut smaller. Drinks-only version ¥385; any other drink on the list is ¥100 off with a meal.

items.ja: 有機ミント緑茶
items.en: Organic mint green tea — the shop's own pairing after a meal, and the drink it recommends for the gut
items.note: 茶葉とミントのみ。Green tea leaf and mint — a leaf infusion, not 麦茶 barley tea. Takeaway ¥540.

items.ja: オーガニック米こうじ和紅茶
items.en: Organic Japanese black tea brewed with rice koji — gently sweet, with the koji aroma on top of the tea
items.note: 和紅茶と米麹のみ。Japanese black tea and rice koji — rice, not barley koji.

items.ja: オーガニックカルダモンコーヒー
items.en: Organic cardamom coffee — relaxing spice aroma over the coffee. Decaf available
items.note: コーヒー豆とカルダモンのみ。Coffee and cardamom pods. Takeaway ¥540.

items.ja: フレーバーティー
items.en: Flavoured tea — rose and mango aromatics
items.note: 茶葉と香料のみ。Tea leaf and flavouring — no cereal.

items.ja: 抹茶
items.en: Matcha, whisked fresh to order
items.note: 抹茶と湯のみ。Powdered green tea and hot water.

items.ja: 抹茶ラテ
items.en: Matcha latte — sweetness adjustable to taste
items.note: 抹茶と牛乳。Matcha and milk — dairy. Ask whether a plant milk is possible.

items.ja: カフェオレ
items.en: Café au lait — coffee with frothed milk
items.note: コーヒーと牛乳。Coffee and milk — dairy.

items.ja: 自家製レモネード（ホット／アイス）
items.en: House lemonade, hot or iced — sweet and tart, from lemons preserved in syrup
items.note: シロップ漬けレモンと水のみ。Syrup-preserved lemon and water — confirm the syrup is sugar and not honey if you are vegan.

items.ja: コーヒー（ホット／アイス）
items.en: Regular coffee, hot or iced
items.note: コーヒー豆のみ。Coffee only.

items.ja: 100％りんごジュース
items.en: 100% apple juice
items.note: 果汁のみ。Pure fruit juice.

items.ja: 本日のお料理盛り合わせ（ワンドリンクつき）
items.en: Today's selection plate with one drink — the evening café's set. 18:00–22:00, Fridays and Saturdays only
items.note: 小麦粉不使用だが、一部料理の醤油に微量の小麦の可能性（店の掲示）。No wheat flour used, but some dishes' soy may carry trace wheat per the shop's notice. Contents change nightly — ask about dashi and egg for vegan.

items.ja: お豆腐ハンバーグ
items.en: Tofu hamburg steak — made with chicken breast and tofu, so much lighter than the usual; served with sudachi
items.note: 通常のハンバーグはパン粉をつなぎに使うが、当店は小麦粉不使用と明記。A normal hamburg is bound with breadcrumbs; this kitchen states it uses no wheat flour at all, which is exactly what makes this dish unusual. The soy in the seasoning is the remaining caveat. Chicken and egg.

items.ja: ガパオライス
items.en: Gapao rice — the evening portion of the Japanese-style basil chicken
items.note: 小麦粉不使用、味付けの醤油に微量の小麦の可能性。No wheat flour; the seasoning soy is the caveat. Chicken, tofu and egg.

items.ja: 夜カレー
items.en: Evening curry — the medicinal spice curry in an evening portion
items.note: スパイスカレーで小麦のルウ不使用。A spice curry, not a wheat-roux curry. Ask whether the evening build is the vegan one.

items.ja: クリームチーズクラッカー
items.en: Crackers with cream cheese
items.note: クラッカーの原材料が未記載。The shop uses no wheat flour in its own baking, but a bought-in cracker is a different question — ask what these are made of before relying on them. Dairy.

items.ja: 味たま
items.en: Seasoned soft-boiled egg — cured in spices and dashi; also sold as a curry topping
items.note: 漬け地に出汁と醤油を使う。The shop's own English text says it is seasoned with spices and dashi; a marinade like that normally carries soy — ask. Egg.

items.ja: 酵素玄米新しょうが寿司
items.en: Enzyme brown rice sushi with new ginger — a seasonal evening plate the shop lists on its own site
items.note: 価格が公表されていない。Price not published on any of the shop's cards — the item appears on the shop's own menu page but not on the photographed evening card. Sushi rice normally carries vinegar and sugar only, but ask.

items.ja: スパイスきのこ春巻き
items.en: Spiced mushroom spring rolls — an evening snack listed on the shop's own site
items.note: 春巻きの皮は通常小麦だが、当店は小麦粉不使用と明記しているため米粉の皮の可能性が高い。A spring roll wrapper is normally wheat, but this kitchen states it uses no wheat flour — so the wrapper is presumably rice-based. Confirm before ordering; the price is not published either.

items.ja: 今日のグラスワイン（赤／白）
items.en: Today's glass wine, red or white — a light Japanese wine chosen to go with the food. Everything on the alcohol list is one price
items.note: ぶどうのみ、穀物不使用。No cereal at any stage; fining agents may be animal-derived.

items.ja: 日本酒
items.en: Seasonal sake — the brand rotates; ask what is open
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。Rice and rice koji; the brand changes, so ask if you need the label.

items.ja: ビール
items.en: Beer
items.note: 麦芽＝大麦。Barley malt — the one thing on this otherwise wheat-free menu that a coeliac must avoid outright.

items.ja: ジンソーダ
items.en: Gin and soda, made with a locally produced gin
items.note: ジンのベーススピリッツが未記載。Gin's base spirit is often grain — distilled, but ask if you are strict.

items.ja: ハイボール／レモンサワー
items.en: Highball or lemon sour
items.note: ハイボールのベース＝ウイスキー＝大麦。A highball is whisky, i.e. barley — never treated as gluten-free here.

items.ja: 桃のおさけ
items.en: Peach sake — soft, comforting sweetness
items.note: ベース酒が未記載。Base spirit unpublished — ask, since a barley shochu base would carry gluten.

items.ja: ゆずのおさけ
items.en: Yuzu sake — fresh and citrusy
items.note: ベース酒が未記載。Base spirit unpublished.

items.ja: 本日の酵素玄米お弁当（テイクアウト）
items.en: Today's enzyme brown rice bento, to take away — the fullest version of the plate, boxed
items.note: 小麦粉不使用、一部料理の醤油に微量の小麦の可能性。No wheat flour; the soy in some dishes is the caveat per the shop's own notice.
